title: A groupoid over a field has the dimension of its stabilizer

standard_prerequisites.name: Equidimensionality of R and G
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: lemma-groupoid-on-field-locally-finite-type-dimension (same chapter, carded L26644) and lemma-group-over-field-locally-finite-type-dimension (same chapter, NOT carded, declared external)
standard_prerequisites.use: Reduces the claim to dim_e(R) = dim_e(G).

standard_prerequisites.name: Unique base field in a variety ring
standard_prerequisites.use: Identifies the integral closures k_a and k_b of the two field images.

core_obligations: Reduce to dim_e(R) = dim_e(G) by equidimensionality.
Take an etale affine chart V at e, pass to the connected component and its reduction T.
Form the two maps a, b : T -> Spec(k); they induce the same field map since phi(v) = e.
Use the unique-base-field proposition to get k_a = k_b, conclude a = b, so T -> R factors through G, whence R_red = G_red near e.
proof_roadmap: Chart reduction to the identity point, then the integral-closure comparison forcing the two structure maps to agree.
difficulty_reason: The unique-base-field argument and the factorization through the stabilizer are non-routine.
